newsitem.title: USA: Seafield ends LabOne merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Seafield ends LabOne merger talks.

text.p: Seafield Capital Corp said Tuesday merger talks between it and its 82 percent-owned subsidiary LabOne Inc have ended, due to the likely additional annual amortization expense caused by such a combination.
Seafield announced in February 1995 that such a merger was one of the strategic alternatives it was considering.
Separately Tuesday, Response Oncology Inc said that Seafield's board had declared a dividend to its shareholders of all the 8,077,392 Response Oncology common shares Seafield owns.
Response Oncology said about 1.24 shares of its common stock will be distributed as a dividend for each Seafield common stock outstanding. The dividend is available to shareholders of record July 11.
The distribution of Seafield's Response Oncology holdings to shareholders had been considered when Seafield first began considering a merger with LabOne.
Seafield said Tuesday that such a distribution would be effected in late July.

Seafield said additionally that it plans to determine an appropriate corporate and expense structure, because these moves leave it with remaining assets of only about $5 million in cash and 10,712,200 LabOne shares.
